title: Australian Tofu Noodles
description: A sweet and pillowy Australian dish featuring silken tofu and bonito flakes, this crowd-pleaser is egg-free friendly and perfect for any occasion.

ingredients.name: silken tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook the noodles according to the package instructions.
Drain the noodles and set them aside.
In a large skillet, heat the sesame oil over medium heat.
Add the bonito flakes and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the cubed tofu to the skillet and stir gently to combine with the sauce.
Add the cooked noodles to the skillet and stir to combine with the tofu and sauce.
Transfer the noodles to a serving platter and garnish with green onions.
